actions.sql: SELECT V.GOODSID AS GOODSID, CASE WHEN DECODE(V.USEFLAG, 4, '原料', 2, '辅料', 3, '非印字包材', 5, '印字包材') IN ('原料', '辅料') THEN NVL(V.USEQTY, 0) / NULLIF(M.APEX_PL, 0) * 1000000 END AS PER_HL, F.PRICE AS PRICE FROM T_COST_PINGGU M JOIN CMX.T_COST_BOM_GOODS_TREE_V V ON V.TREEID LIKE '-' || :goodsId || '-%' JOIN T_COST_GOODS G ON G.GOODSID = V.GOODSID LEFT JOIN CMX.PUB_GOODS_V F ON F.GOODSID = V.GOODSID WHERE M.DOCID = :docId AND V.PID <> '-1' AND V.USEFLAG NOT IN (0, 1) AND G.USEFLAG IN ('原料', '辅料') ORDER BY V.TREEID

SELECT V.GOODSID AS GOODSID, CASE WHEN DECODE(V.USEFLAG, 4, '原料', 2, '辅料', 3, '非印字包材', 5, '印字包材') IN ('原料', '辅料') THEN NVL(V.USEQTY, 0) / NULLIF(M.APEX_PL, 0) * 1000000 END AS PER_HL, F.PRICE AS PRICE FROM T_COST_PINGGU M JOIN CMX.T_COST_BOM_GOODS_TREE_V V ON V.TREEID LIKE '-' || :goodsId || '-%' JOIN T_COST_GOODS G ON G.GOODSID = V.GOODSID LEFT JOIN CMX.PUB_GOODS_V F ON F.GOODSID = V.GOODSID WHERE M.DOCID = :docId AND V.PID <> '-1' AND V.USEFLAG NOT IN (0, 1) AND G.USEFLAG IN ('非印字包材', '印字包材') ORDER BY V.TREEID
